title: Kale Caesar Pasta Salad with Crispy Chickpeas
style: Fresh, creamy, and hearty pasta salad with crispy roasted chickpeas and vibrant kale
description: A hearty and nourishing kale Caesar pasta salad tossed in a creamy vegan-friendly dressing and topped with crispy smoked chickpeas.
steps: Roast the Chickpeas: Preheat oven to 190°C / 375°F. Dry chickpeas thoroughly using paper towels and remove loose skins.
Toss chickpeas with olive oil, smoked paprika, and salt. Spread on a baking tray and roast for 30–40 minutes until crispy.
Make the Dressing: Add olive oil, lemon juice, tahini, Dijon mustard, garlic, nutritional yeast, salt, pepper, and water to a blender.
Blend until smooth and creamy. Adjust consistency with more water or lemon juice if needed.
Assemble the Salad: In a large bowl, combine cooked pasta, shredded kale, roasted chickpeas, and parmesan cheese.
Pour over the dressing and toss well until everything is evenly coated.
Serve immediately or chill slightly before serving.
tips: Massage the kale with a little olive oil for a softer texture.
Dry chickpeas thoroughly before roasting — this is the difference between soft and crispy.
Salt your pasta water well for better flavour.
Cook pasta just to al dente so it holds up in the salad.
Add extra parmesan if you want a richer, more indulgent flavour.
Thin the dressing with water or lemon juice depending on your preference.
